authority.classification: The identity-safe research-only exogenous acquisition factor is the sole eligible post-selector direction. This fixed-cohort panel may measure run-level package co-play support and interference only; it does not establish exact mechanism activation, policy choice sensitivity or causal benefit.

researchQuestion: On the exact frozen 64-policy common-random-number cohort, does forcing executioner or guardedStrike produce sufficiently selective, viable run-level co-play support for its intended package, without material cross-package interference or global outcome and duration movement, to justify one separately preregistered exact-mechanism trace?
claimBoundary: This panel estimates run-level co-play support under two exogenous acquisition levels. Co-play is not exact mechanism activation, and an exogenous level is not an observed policy choice. No payoff, exact causal interaction, product acceptance, held-out confirmation, protected-seed result or shipping fitness is estimated.

levels.off: Immutable exact-current baseline with no extra acquisition.
levels.executioner: Add exactly one existing executioner to the Dusk deck through the identity-safe existing deck, UID and save representation before the frozen run.
levels.guardedStrike: Add exactly one existing guardedStrike to the Dusk deck through the identity-safe existing deck, UID and save representation before the frozen run.

scorelinePayoff.level: exact current Chisel and executioner authored effects

afterimagePayoff.level: exact current defend and guardedStrike authored effects

acquisitionPriority.level: exogenously assigned acquisition with exact frozen root-552 policy identities

scoreline.coPlayPredicate: chiselPlayed > 0 and executionerPlayed > 0 within the same complete run

afterimage.coPlayPredicate: defendPlayed > 0 and guardedStrikePlayed > 0 within the same complete run

anchors.toolchain: Every new process uses only /Applications/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot at 4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf and its frozen binary SHA-256.
anchors.content: All arms use content a0d608a5142d2e3aab799cdf33d3163922b402c2aaf2a895e46e096399b56cf1 and search space 524f277331012daeec1a70d9c193141c4b8cfa4723f896341e25547e99c72bca.

baselineAnchors.definition: A policy is a robust baseline co-play anchor when the package predicate is true on at least three of its four frozen seeds.

estimands.robustCoPlaySupport: For each intended arm, the number of policies whose package co-play predicate is true on at least three of four frozen seeds.
estimands.exactInactivity: For each intended arm, the number of policies whose package co-play predicate is false on all four frozen seeds.
estimands.robustConsumerDraw: For each intended arm, the number of policies that draw the added consumer on at least three of four frozen seeds.
estimands.viability: For each intended arm, the number of robust co-play policies with at least one expressed winning run.
estimands.intendedAnchorGain: The number of robust intended-package policies under the intended arm that were not robust anchors in the shared baseline.
estimands.functionalSeparation: Counts of intended robust support unique to Scoreline and Afterimage and the Jaccard overlap of the two intended robust sets.
estimands.crossPackageInterference: Symmetric-difference count between each non-intended package robust set under the opposite acquisition and its preregistered baseline anchor set.
estimands.winMovement: Policy-clustered paired mean candidate-minus-baseline win indicator with a fixed 5,000-resample percentile interval.
estimands.durationMovement: Policy-clustered paired mean candidate-minus-baseline turns per fight with a fixed 5,000-resample percentile interval.
estimands.reliability: Complete cardinality and zero stall, error or non-empty error field in both enabled rectangles.
estimands.notEstimated: Exact card-order mechanism activation, target state, damage attribution, payoff effects, payoff interactions, policy choice sensitivity, RandomBuild, protected seeds, product UI or acceptance.

mechanisticInteractions.reason: Scoreline payoff, Afterimage payoff, Faultline rarity and Ward setup priority are separate fixed factors. The panel measures support and shared-anchor interference, not a payoff interaction.
mechanisticInteractions.expansionRule: No joint cell may be added from this panel. Only a success disposition may preregister the cheapest exact-mechanism trace; additional joint cells require measured interference decision value in a later immutable protocol.

aliasStructure.coPlay: Run-level producer and consumer co-play can include unrelated fights and ordering; it is not exact activation, exact package use or causal mediation.
aliasStructure.forcedAcquisition: An exogenously added card is not a policy choice and cannot establish policy repertoire sufficiency.
aliasStructure.payoffs: Scoreline and Afterimage payoff remain separate fixed factors; neither is aliased into acquisition or pooled into a four-factor description.
aliasStructure.baseline: The same off rows anchor both intended gains, both cross-package checks and both global guardrails.
aliasStructure.arms: Executioner and guardedStrike are two levels of one acquisition factor in separate mechanism blocks, not an invitation to complete a Cartesian product.

staging.mechanicalFirst: Validate every immutable hash, source equivalence, probe anchor, cache identity, baseline schema, baseline anchor set and complete deterministic plan before execution.
staging.sentinelSecond: Run the first four frozen policies across all four seeds in both enabled arms, for 32 rows used only for schema, policy identity and reliability. A fault stops before expansion; scientific support endpoints are not inspected at this stage.
staging.remainderThird: Only after a reliable sentinel, run the remaining 60 policies across the same four seeds in both arms, for 480 rows. Neither arm receives a different cohort or support-conditioned expansion.

probeContract.enabledGuard: The support probe accepts only executioner or guardedStrike; off, omitted and every other value fail before content execution.

sourceEquivalence.rule: Every listed semantic and driver source is byte-identical to identity v2. Only the support-only probe is new.

comparisonContract.nestedFields: packageEvents and policy must be dictionaries; fights must be a non-empty array of dictionaries with turns.
comparisonContract.policyIdentity: Every enabled row must reproduce the exact baseline resolved-policy dictionary for the same policy index and simulation seed.
comparisonContract.normalisation: No field removal, row selection, imputation, endpoint staging or cohort change is permitted.

estimator.withinPolicy: Mean the four paired seed differences before resampling.
estimator.bootstrap: Exactly 5,000 policy-cluster resamples with Python random.Random seeds 423100 and 423101 for win, and 423110 and 423111 for duration.
estimator.supportRule: At least three of four seeds for robust co-play or robust draw; zero of four for exact inactivity.

decisionRules.success: Every immutable and mechanical preflight passes; the sentinel has complete schema, exact policy identities and zero faults; both complete 256-row enabled rectangles pass every fixed support, inactivity, draw, viability, gain, separation, interference, reliability and Vow-5 gate; each win interval lies wholly within plus or minus 0.10; each duration interval upper bound is at most 0.25; the ledger is unchanged and all numeric ceilings hold.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Freeze this one explicit-acquisition factor, with its two mechanism-blocked levels, only for one separately preregistered exact-mechanism trace. Do not call co-play activation, admit a product candidate, use held-out or protected seeds, vary a payoff, add a joint cell or introduce ML, RL or another optimiser.
decisionRules.futility: After a green mechanical preflight, the reliable complete panel fails any fixed gate, a win movement point estimate exceeds plus or minus 0.10, a duration movement lower interval exceeds 0.25, or the sentinel contains a fault.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Close this exact exogenous acquisition scalar family without retune, subgroup rescue, another arm, cohort change, threshold change or rerun, then continue inside issue 421 with the next evidence-backed structural mechanism.
decisionRules.inconclusive: A required immutable artefact, cache, source identity, schema, provenance, ledger identity or numeric cap fails before a valid endpoint decision, or all fixed gates avoid futility but a win or duration interval does not fit wholly inside its success bound.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Record this exact panel inconclusive at its preregistered cap. Do not repair, rerun, create v2, inspect a promising subgroup or expand the design. Continue only as permitted by issue 421 and the controlling owner decision.

executionAndStopping.construction: Deterministic Python validates immutable evidence, constructs plans, invokes the exact Godot binary, content-addresses plans and outputs, maps paired identities, computes fixed support and clustered estimands and writes one summary.
executionAndStopping.firstLook: The 32-row sentinel is used only for schema, policy identity and reliability. Promising support cannot alter expansion.
automaticDisposition: Success freezes at most the exact acquisition factor for a separately preregistered mechanism trace.
A valid fixed-gate failure closes the exact scalar family.
Unavailable evidence or unresolved interval at the cap records inconclusive.

methodBoundary: Issues 524 and 525 remain immutable evidence and are not reconstructed. The closed score selector is not retuned. No ML, RL, optimiser, candidate-by-candidate adaptation, product mutation, PR, Actions or protected seed is authorised by this panel.
